name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Solutions Consultant | SaaS Discovery, Consultative Selling & Implementation

At Accelo, I sold and scoped a CRM and professional-services automation platform (project management, time tracking, billing) to agencies and professional-services firms, ranking top three on a team of 8 to 15 while quota roughly doubled. Denver-based, with close family ties to K-12 education.
